result.summary: The screen is largely well-composed with consistent spacing, alignment and typography. The main observable inconsistency is that the 'Pizza' category filter appears selected, yet the listed restaurants (poké, burgers, ramen) are not pizza-related, suggesting the filter state and content are out of sync. No overlapping, clipped, or misaligned elements were found beyond the permitted carousel/viewport truncation.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' filter chip is rendered in the active/selected state, but the content below (Green Bowl Poké, Smash Bros Burgers, Tokumaru Ramen Bar) is not filtered to pizza, so the visible selection state does not match the displayed results.
issues.suggestion: Either apply the pizza filter to the listed sections when the chip is active, or reset the chip to the default 'All' state so the UI state matches the content shown.
